summary.plain: A compact detector made of many silicon sensors around the collision point, which counted nearly all the charged particles and their directions, with two small magnetic spectrometers for a detailed look at a small fraction.
summary.technical: PHOBOS: silicon detector arrays surrounding the interaction region for multiplicity and angular distributions, two magnetic spectrometers (about one percent of produced particles), time-of-flight walls moved farther out before the 2003 run, and calorimeters.

technology.quote: PHOBOS consisted of many silicon detectors surrounding the interaction region. With these detectors, physicists are able to count the total number of produced particles and study their angular distribution.
technology.value: Silicon multiplicity detectors surrounding the interaction region with two high-quality magnetic spectrometers
